identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a Library LMS that feels like a lifestyle app, not a filing cabinet.
core_principles: Fusion: Mix Spotify discovery with Notion utility.
Content First: Book covers and course art are the heroes.
Negative Space: generous padding (p-8+) to reduce cognitive load.
Contrast: High definition borders and shadows.

theme_strategy.description: A split-personality interface. The 'Academic' side is structured, cool, and precise (Swiss Style). The 'Leisure' side is organic, warm, and playful (Neo-Brutalist Pop).

headings.usage: All Section Headers, Hero Titles, Modal Titles

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI Labels, Inputs, Data Tables

primary.name: Electric Indigo
primary.usage: Brand core, Primary Buttons, Active States

academic.name: Slate Teal
academic.usage: Academic Section Headers, Progress Bars, Study Badges

leisure.name: Sunset Orange
leisure.usage: Leisure Section Headers, 'Rent' Buttons, Fun Tags

global.spacing: Relaxed. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers. gap-6 for grids.
global.responsive: Mobile-first. Stacked columns on < md. Sidebar becomes bottom nav on mobile.

dashboards.student: Bento Grid Mode A. Hero section showing 'Current Read' or 'Next Class'.
dashboards.admin: High Density Grid Mode B. Data tables with sticky headers.
dashboards.librarian: Utility focus. Search bar prominent. Quick actions for Check-in/out.

sections.academic_browse: Structured List or Dense Grid. Focus on metadata (Grade, Subject).
sections.leisure_browse: Masonry or Asymmetrical Grid. Focus on cover art and vibes.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.academic_action: bg-white border border-teal-200 text-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-50 rounded-md shadow-sm
buttons.leisure_action: bg-orange-500 text-white hover:bg-orange-600 rounded-xl shadow-lg hover:shadow-orange-500/25

cards.book_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all hover:-translate-y-1
cards.course_card: border-l-4 border-l-primary bg-white shadow-sm p-6 rounded-r-xl
cards.stat_card: bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between

navigation.sidebar: Fixed left (desktop). w-64. Border-r. Glassmorphism optional. Links have rounded-md hover states.
navigation.mobile_nav: Fixed bottom. High z-index. Solid background with top border. Icon-heavy.

feedback.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the layout (not spinners).

icons.recommendation: Use phosphor-icons/react (Duotone) for specific leisure section icons if available, otherwise Lucide.

landing_hero.alt: Students collaborating in a modern library
landing_hero.usage: Main landing page hero background or split visuals.

leisure_vibes.usage: Leisure section banner or promo card.

digital_learning.usage: Course dashboard or Academic section highlight.

motion.hover_effects: Scale 1.02 on cards. Color shift on links.
motion.list_entrance: Staggered fade-in (Framer Motion recommended if available, otherwise CSS keyframes).

accessibility_rules.contrast: Ensure text over images has a bg-black/40 overlay or text-shadow.
accessibility_rules.focus: Visible ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility_rules.labels: All icon-only buttons must have aria-label.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Auth: Create a 'RoleGuard' component early to handle the 6 user roles.
3. Dashboard: Do not build one generic dashboard. Build a 'DashboardShell' layout, then specific widgets for Student vs Admin.
4. Store: For the Leisure section, use a 'Shopping Cart' context even if payment is mock.
5. PDF: For certificates, use a simple HTML-to-PDF print style or a lightweight library.
6. Tables: Use Shadcn Table for inventory/users. Do not build custom divs for tables.
7. Mobile: Verify the Sidebar collapses correctly on mobile.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. No gradients as primary backgrounds.
Do not center-align main content text; keep it left-aligned for readability.
